# Build Your Own AI Bot (RAG for non-technical people) — key ideas (one page)

## What you can now do

- Build a working bot from your own documents without code
- Diagnose why a bot is wrong and fix it
- Know which settings to change and what they do
- Estimate running cost
- Know what to ask an engineer for

## The sentences to remember

1. **Day 1 — a bot that answers from one document (and admits when it can't)** — “A good bot has two skills: finding the page, and saying 'it is not in here'. Test both from day one.”
2. **Day 2 — building the library: clean, chunk, label, permit** — “Rubbish in the folder is rubbish in the answer. Curating twenty good documents beats indexing two thousand.”
3. **Day 3 — finding the right page: one change at a time** — “One change, one measurement. If you change three things and it improves, you learned nothing.”
4. **Day 4 — answering well and going live: the launch check** — “'Not found' is not a failure. It is a number on your dashboard that tells you which document to write next.”

## Try it again

Every demo from this course runs on your own laptop: `python demos/NN_name.py` inside this course folder, or from the *Course labs* section of the `/demos` page.
